SKHX 2026Q2 preview: historical reconstruction.
This document is a retrospective reconstruction. It was not written before the Q2 earnings release. It uses only the 1Q26 release published by SK hynix on April 23, 2026. The target event is the 2026Q2 earnings release.

Conclusion
SK hynix reported record first-quarter results. Revenue was KRW 52.5763 trillion. Operating profit was KRW 37.6103 trillion. Operating margin was 72%. Net profit was KRW 40.3459 trillion. The company expects AI to move toward agentic AI. It expects this to expand both DRAM and NAND demand. It forecasts favorable pricing for both products. If these conditions continue, Q2 revenue and profit should remain high. If conditions improve, sequential growth is possible. The 72% operating margin leaves limited room for further margin expansion. The key question is sustainability, not just growth.

Last-quarter baseline
All figures are K-IFRS and preliminary. Quarterly revenue rose 60% QoQ and 198% YoY. Operating profit rose 96% QoQ and 405% YoY. Net profit rose 165% QoQ and 398% YoY. Cash and equivalents were KRW 54.3 trillion. Interest-bearing debt was KRW 19.3 trillion. Net cash was KRW 35.0 trillion.

Core questions for Q2
First, can AI demand remain strong despite seasonal patterns? Q1 is normally a seasonal downturn, but demand stayed strong. Second, can new products improve the mix? The company plans to ramp LPDDR6, SOCAMM2, and PQC21. Third, will higher investment spending reduce net cash? The company says investment will rise significantly this year.

Positive and negative gaps
Positive gaps: The company forecasts favorable pricing for DRAM and NAND. Agentic AI should broaden memory demand. New products can increase the high-value mix.
Negative gaps: The record base and 72% margin make margin expansion difficult. Higher capital spending may pressure cash flow. The 1Q26 numbers are preliminary and may change.

Earnings checkpoints
Check whether revenue stays above KRW 50 trillion. Check the operating margin against 72%. Check HBM, server DRAM module, and eSSD sales commentary. Check LPDDR6, SOCAMM2, and PQC21 ramp commentary. Check cash, debt, net cash, and capex details.
reader_questions: 若2Q26营收环比持平、营业利润率低于72%，是否仍算符合公司指引？公司只给出定性指引，除公告外无共识，因此正文应避免预设“增长”为唯一基准。
公司说“客户需求超过供应能力”，同时又预测“内存效率技术会扩大服务规模并拉动需求”；如果效率技术降低单位内存用量，2Q26需求是否会先于价格兑现？正文是否把两种逻辑混为一谈？
“投资规模显著增长”和“净现金35万亿”同时出现，2Q26是否可能看到自由现金流转负？正文不应假装知道答案，而应把资本开支列为验证点。
fact_checks: 核对日期与季度：公告发布于2026-04-23，标题为1Q26/4Q2025对比；目标季度为2026Q2，正文未将1Q26数字当作2Q26结果。
核对币种与单位：原表单位为Billion KRW，正文使用万亿韩元（1万亿韩元=1,000亿韩元）；营收52,576.3亿韩元=52.5763万亿韩元，换算正确。
核对GAAP口径：所有财务数据均基于K-IFRS，且公告标注preliminary、FY2026 Q1审计未定稿；正文在基线段落注明初步数据。
核对集团/分部：公告为合并SK hynix Inc.整体业绩，未给出HBM、DRAM或NAND分部利润；正文不编造分部盈利。
核对公司指引：DRAM与NAND价格环境继续有利、AI走向agentic AI、投资规模显著增加均为公司前瞻性表述，非实际业绩；正文将其归因于公司。
核对产品计划：LPDDR6为全球首次全面出货计划、SOCAMM2为当月量产、PQC21为产品名；正文按公告表述写，不将产品计划推演为收入或利润。
核对现金/债务：1Q26末现金及等价物54.3万亿韩元，有息负债19.3万亿韩元，净现金35万亿韩元；来源正文一致。
核对无外部共识：资料中无分析师共识或股价数据，正文未给出量化目标或股价预期。
